title: Naive Bayes Spam Filter
blurb: Classify SMS or email as spam with a hand-built Naive Bayes model and TF-IDF features.
brief: Build a spam classifier from scratch: text cleaning and tokenization, a vocabulary built from the training set, a Naive Bayes classifier with Laplace smoothing working in log space, and a TF-IDF baseline for comparison. Use a public dataset such as the UCI SMS Spam Collection, split it properly, and report precision and recall with an error analysis of the messages you get wrong.
requirements: A vocabulary built only from the training split
Naive Bayes with Laplace smoothing, computed with log probabilities
A train/test split and metrics (precision, recall, F1, confusion matrix)
Error analysis: print and discuss misclassified examples
deliverables: Model code and an evaluation script
README with dataset source, results and error analysis
Tests for tokenization and for the smoothing behavior on unseen words
stretch: Expose a small command-line classify tool
resume_bullet: Built a Naive Bayes + TF-IDF spam classifier from scratch with Laplace smoothing in log-space; achieved strong precision/recall with documented error analysis.
